target: Working Clay Machine: ClayCode language + compiler + VM + Clay environment + Linux interoperability + minimal ClayOS

CM-01-LANGUAGE-SPEC-PARSER-IR.goal: Canonical ClayCode syntax, parser, AST/IR and corpus authority with unknown constructs failing closed.
CM-01-LANGUAGE-SPEC-PARSER-IR.call_ownership_evidence: PR #598 merged a syntax-only partition of bare unqualified versus dotted callee targets; no import/member/host semantics selected.

CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.goal: Nominal/structural type and effect semantics independent of Python recursion/host defaults, with bounded complexity and explicit semantic authority.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.blocker: The copy-per-branch alias ancestry complexity defect is repaired on product main by PR #603. Remaining TypeRef resource-totality work is compact alias-DAG expansion/materialization: stack-total traversal and linear ancestry bookkeeping do not by themselves bound output growth.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.production_repair: PR #603 merged as 2a83f79c8d7fe31a835fdb6c8f20c94b702eb834. It replaces ancestry copies with one mutable DFS active-alias path plus explicit leave frames without selecting new generic/member/host semantics.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.duplicate_candidate: PR #605 closed unmerged after PR #603 production integration; retained only as independent supporting evidence.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.next_discriminator: Define and enforce a bounded policy for alias-DAG expansion/materialization or structural sharing/hash-consing, then prove fail-closed resource behavior without changing nominal alias meaning.

CM-03-EVALUATOR-INTERPRETER.goal: Fail-closed executable ClayCode evaluator for admitted language semantics; no host behavior by default.

CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.goal: Define lowering and executable bytecode/IR with deterministic verifier and compiler receipts.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.canonical_executable_ir: PR #609 merged as 1bf95a2bf6912c7d40585a70d4a65221cf8fcd19. ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 is materialized from the existing structured parser/analyzer only after production nominal typecheck admission; raw body_tokens are not reparsed.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.single_vm_lowering: PR #614 merged as 5591da02c4a9260445f4c355d7606aa0703245f1. It lowers only the already-shared semantic intersection from ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 into the one serialized/verifiable ClayVM core and differentially checks source-tree versus VM behavior.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.supporting_replication: PR #613 exact head 67ac82378e70f068a426d4c87f3b75b8065eb6f4 passed 5/5 and is closed unmerged; its temporary ClayCodeExecutableTypedIR/v0 wrapper is superseded as authority by merged ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1 and retained only as independent checked-source/single-VM evidence.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.blocker: A real canonical compiler path exists for a deliberately tiny PURE intersection. Provenance is now bound by ClayVMArtifact/v1 for the protected launch path; remaining CM-04 work is to expand bytecode/lowering only for semantics already admitted by ClayExecutableTypedIR/v1, without backend-local language/type reinvention.

CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.goal: Implement Clay VM instruction semantics, execution loop, call/stack/object model, traps, limits and deterministic tests.
CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.production_candidate: The fresh-main single ClayVM core from PR #608 merged as 94efad064602689dfc3c9a5b3e9cab0136ed9d0a, is integrated with canonical executable IR by PR #614, and can now be wrapped in a provenance-bound ClayVMArtifact/v1 by merged PR #619.
CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.current_blocker: The provenance-bound artifact path is verified, but legacy callers can still invoke raw load_module(CL​AYVM/1) directly. Production/ClayOS launch routing must become non-bypassable for canonical programs before artifact provenance is release authority. The current instruction/type surface also remains intentionally narrow.

CM-06-MEMORY-CONCURRENCY-RUNTIME.goal: Define VM memory/object lifetime, concurrency/scheduling and failure semantics.

CM-07-CLAY-ENVIRONMENT-STDLIB-SDK.goal: A self-contained Clay environment directory/runtime with standard library, modules, packaging and developer SDK.

CM-08-LINUX-INTEROP.goal: Typed capability-bound Linux filesystem/process/network/device/FFI interop with explicit effects, receipts and fail-closed boundaries.
CM-08-LINUX-INTEROP.candidate: The merged ClayVM core contains a capability-only host boundary; this is bootstrap evidence only, not deep typed Linux interop acceptance.

CM-09-MINIMAL-CLAYOS.goal: Minimal ClayOS services/shell/runtime personality hosted by the Clay VM/environment, sufficient to demonstrate boot, program execution, state and Linux interaction.
CM-09-MINIMAL-CLAYOS.candidate: The merged ClayVM core contains a minimal RUNNING/EXITED/TRAPPED process facade. It does not yet force canonical program launches through ClayVMArtifact/v1, so provenance-aware launch routing remains open.

CM-10-TOOLING-OBSERVABILITY-RECOVERY.goal: Compiler/VM diagnostics, fuzzing, replay, crash/recovery, provenance, performance and reproducibility gates.
CM-10-TOOLING-OBSERVABILITY-RECOVERY.provenance_artifact: PR #619 merged as 156cce431946630b6ef792ab3a65b4734b7df65d. ClayVMArtifact/v1 deterministically wraps the unchanged CLAYVM/1 core and binds source, grammar, canonical executable-IR and core-blob hashes; admission requires caller-supplied expected identity and fails closed on transplant/tamper/substitution controls.
CM-10-TOOLING-OBSERVABILITY-RECOVERY.current_frontier: Make production/ClayOS canonical launch routing consume ClayVMArtifact/v1 non-bypassably, while leaving raw CLAYVM loading explicitly internal/test-only. Then add recovery/replay/longer-horizon artifact lineage gates.

CM-11-SELF-HOSTING-BOOTSTRAP.goal: Progressively move selected compiler/runtime components into ClayCode and prove bootstrap equivalence without circular trust.

frontier.next_discriminator: Inventory raw load_module/ClayOS.exec_blob production entry points and route canonical ClayOS/program launches through ClayVMArtifact/v1 non-bypassably; preserve raw core loading only as an explicitly internal/test primitive. Then expand additional already-admitted PURE semantics into this same VM. Parallel bounded CM-02 path: make compact alias-DAG expansion resource-safe.

coordination_negative_result: Parallel GO workers can collide on exactly-one unusual-experiment cardinality and shared frontiers. CAS/lease discipline remains required. This macrocycle also exposed and repaired a CI provenance pitfall: github.sha in pull_request workflows is a merge ref unless the workflow explicitly checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha.
laws: ClayVerse/Clay Machine is the only active program.
GRF expands hypotheses but does not mint truth.
Legacy Frank/self.root/UCM2 paths are evidence only.
No hidden host semantics, generic semantics, effect authority, or completion claims from names or model consensus.
No final paid training without explicit owner authorization.
